items.guidance: In this Express app, look in the server entry (likely under server/, alongside server/worker.js) for where the app instance and middleware are registered, and check existing routes for any lightweight unauthenticated GET such as a ping or status handler. If none exists, register the new route on the app instance ahead of the auth, passport/session, rate-limit, or redirect middleware. Confirm it responds 200 on port 3000, then report the path for the Deployz health check setting.
